profile.name: EASTERN POWER GROUP PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.businessType: Company operate in two main business in Printing and Power plant. In printing, the company is producer of printing and one-stop service printing house-from planning to binding. In Power plant, the company's business is to generate and sell electricity from renewable energy as well as investing in companies that generate and sell electricity from co-generation power plant.
